trigger: srcSmoke failed with SEG=0 after branch recovery; VCD showed x8 was renamed to p0 after a JAL redirect although the frame-pointer addi had committed.

files_modified.notes: Only retirement entries that allocated a destination physical register now drive commit_arch_o/commit_prd_o to RenameUnit. Non-writing uops keep commit_valid_o for retire/perf/store-buffer purposes but no longer update aRAT with pseudo rd bits.
Recorded the aRAT commit-map corruption fix and the intended verification cascade.

notes: Root cause: store and branch instructions still carry instruction bits in the decoded rd field. CommitUnit previously forwarded that field to RenameUnit whenever commit_valid_o was high, so a store such as fe042423 could update aRAT[x8] to p0. A later branch/JAL recovery restored sRAT from the corrupted aRAT, causing loads using x8 as a base to address 0xffffffdc instead of the stack frame.
